_note: One sentence per gallery screenshot, keyed by app and gallery label. Shown under the large screenshot on each app page.

Timing.Live race: A four-lane race in full swing: race clock, laps to go, track conditions, a live leaderboard with fuel and tyres, and a lap-time chart.
Timing.Race setup: Pick a race setup, put a driver and car in every lane and start. Home also shows the track record and the last podium.
Timing.Results: The Race Director's final check: review laps, adjust or disqualify, then finalise the result.
Timing.Fuel: Set tank size, consumption and refuel speed, and see straight away how many laps a full tank lasts.
Timing.Tyre wear: Choose compounds and wear rates, pit-stop time and what worn tyres do to the car.
Timing.Weather: Plan when the rain comes and goes, and what the wrong tyres cost in penalties, fuel and refuelling.
Timing.Widget Builder: Build your own race-screen widgets from blocks, starting from a ready-made template.
Timing.Audio calls: Give your race a voice: 134 race calls and 39 ambient sounds, each with its own words or recording.
Timing.Race Director: Decide how penalties, time and laps are adjusted during a race, with pads on every lane card.
Timing.Help: Built-in guides, from your first race to every Race System. Available offline.

Paddock.Showroom: Your favourite cars, presented the way they deserve.
Paddock.Car collection: Every car in one place, with photos, specifications and quick filters.
Paddock.Parts catalogue: Keep motors, gears, magnets and every other part organised and easy to find.
Paddock.Wheels & tyres: Track wheel and tyre combinations, sizes and what fits which car.
Paddock.Shopping lists: Know what to buy next, and what you already have.
Paddock.Build from Scratch: Plan a new build, part by part, before it hits the track.
Paddock.Workshop: Every workshop change in one history, car by car.
Paddock.Workshop job: Record a job step by step: what changed, which parts and why.
Paddock.Import & export: Move cars and collections in and out, or share selected cars with a friend.
Paddock.Appearance: Make Paddock your own with themes and display options.

Circuit.Track builder: Lay out a multi-lane track piece by piece, with the parts list and track overview always in view.
Circuit.Live Preview: Watch cars lap your design before you build a single piece.
Circuit.Routed track: Design a routed wooden track with flowing curves on a fixed table.
Circuit.FreeForm: Draw one lane freely and let Circuit generate the others, with editable points.
Circuit.Measure & check: Check footprint, lane lengths, gaps and curves before you build.
Circuit.Table Designer: Plan the table, panel splits and transport sizes to fit your room.
Circuit.Owned pieces & shopping: Compare the layout with the track you own and get a shopping list for the rest.
Circuit.Track packs: Start from manufacturer track packs, with every piece drawn to scale.
Circuit.Import & export: Export your layout to share, print or send to Timing's Live Track.

Telemetry.Workbench: Your setup and lap data side by side, ready to explore.
Telemetry.Setup analysis: See how each setup change affected pace and consistency.
Telemetry.Compare setups: Put two setups next to each other and spot what really made the difference.
Telemetry.Setup library: Keep every setup you have tried, searchable and ready to reuse.
Telemetry.Lap analysis: Dig into lap times, spread and the laps that cost you most.
Telemetry.Progress: Follow your improvement over sessions and weeks.
Telemetry.Driver Feedback: Describe how the car feels and get suggested checks to try next.
Telemetry.Ballast planner: Plan where weight goes and what it does to the balance of the car.
Telemetry.Tyre wear & clearance: Keep an eye on tyre wear and ground clearance before they cost you laps.

Livery.Design studio: Paint stripes, numbers and sponsors on your car, with every layer editable.
Livery.Decals & race numbers: Fit decals and race numbers onto the body, skewed to match the angle of the car.
Livery.Gradients & stripes: Multi-stop gradients and stripe tools for a paint job that stands out.
Livery.Template preparation: Turn any car drawing into a paintable template: label bodywork, glass, lights and wheels.
Livery.User Library: Keep your decals, stripes and shapes ready for the next design.
Livery.Workshop notes: Paint references and masking steps go along with the design and into the PDF.
Livery.Transparent PNG: Export a finished car as a transparent image for posters, websites or entry lists.
Livery.Welcome: Start a new livery, open a project or pick up where you left off.

Decals.Sheet editor: A full A4 sheet of decals at true model size, with layers, rulers and margins.
Decals.Racing graphics: Curved lettering, number plates and racing stripes, all editable.
Decals.Car preview: Check every decal on a car at its printed size before you print.
Decals.Vector tracing: Turn a logo into clean, flat-colour shapes ready to print.
Decals.Slice & export: Export the sheet as PDF or SVG, including white ink for clear paper.
Decals.Decal library: Save decals and sheets to reuse or share with another builder.
Decals.Scale conversion: Convert a whole sheet between scales, for example 1:32 to 1:24.

Foundry.Special pieces: A double-crossover hairpin from the Special pieces shelf, with its isolated braid ends marked on the model.
Foundry.Track Set: Edit the road, cross-section, borders, markings and joints of a piece, with its live dimensions.
Foundry.Track Planner: Snap pieces into a layout and count every part you need to print.
Foundry.Planner in 3D: Check the generated 3D sections before you export them.
Foundry.Single-lane pit: A single-lane pit with its printed flipper and pit lane.
Foundry.STL Edit: Create, edit and repair STL models, from a bracket to a fix on someone else’s part.
Foundry.Home: Pick a starter pack, open a part or start a new pack from a Circuit drawing.
Foundry.Settings: Choose your printer and plate, and make Foundry look the way you want.
